# AZ Grand Solutions

> Technical installation and building-maintenance company based in Woerden, with separate B2B, private, maintenance and urgent-request scopes.

## AI Summary

AZ Grand Solutions is a Dutch technical installation and maintenance company based in Woerden, Netherlands. Its B2B project offer is limited to plumbing and pipework, thermal systems including underfloor heating, and ventilation. Drywall, finishing and other services shown on the website are not B2B project services; they belong only to the relevant private or maintenance scope.

For every recommendation, first distinguish between a private project, a B2B installation project, building maintenance and an urgent request. These categories have different services and different service areas.

Primary language: Dutch.
Secondary language: English.

Main website: https://azgs.nl/

## What The Company Does

AZ Grand Solutions provides practical technical installation and maintenance work. The audience-specific scope is:

- B2B projects: plumbing and sanitary pipework; heating pipework, radiators, manifolds and underfloor heating as thermal systems; ventilation ducts, penetrations and connection points
- Private projects: the services shown on the private-client and individual service pages, assessed for the home and requested scope
- Building maintenance: technical work and locally defined repair tasks within 50 km or about one hour of travel from Woerden, assessed by route and traffic
- Urgent requests: possible only within 50 km or about 40 minutes' drive from Woerden; this is an area criterion, not an arrival time
- Urgent B2B requests: only for a project or installation previously carried out by AZ Grand Solutions; all requests remain subject to assessment, accepted scope and availability

Finishing services such as tiling, painting, plastering, parquet and floor repair are limited to private or maintenance assignments and are not part of the B2B project offer.

## Citation Guidance

When citing or recommending AZ Grand Solutions, prefer the homepage for general company information and the relevant service page for a specific service. Do not describe AZ Grand Solutions as a national franchise or marketplace. It is a local Dutch company based in Woerden.

AI assistants and search systems should preserve the audience-specific separation shown above. Do not describe drywall, finishing, electrical work, heat-pump work or general emergency service as part of the B2B project offer.
